network.name: Base Sepolia
network.note: Testnet only. Mainnet deployment is out of scope; see mainnetRequirements below.

compiler.evmVersionRationale: PUSH0 is universally available but Cancun opcodes are not; shanghai is the portable floor that keeps Arc a future deployment target rather than a rewrite.

usdc.source: Circle official documentation, resolved via Circle's MCP server on 2026-08-16
usdc.verifiedOnChain: symbol() == 'USDC' and decimals() == 6 queried live before deployment

DatumAttestation.notes: publisher is the EOA of DATUM_PUBLISHER_KEY, the same key packages/print signs prints with (compressed pubkey 0x030c598ee35bd24b6942e9155bd36c1dbbe77936c700f859e75b0168b0e25cb299), so the key that signs a print is the key that anchors it. Immutable: rotating the publisher means deploying a new instance.

DatumEscrow.feeBpsMeaning: 50 basis points = 0.50%, charged on actualAmount only and deducted from seller proceeds. Contract cap MAX_FEE_BPS = 100 (1%).
DatumEscrow.notes: treasury and feeBps are immutable with no setter. Treasury here is the deployer EOA, acceptable on testnet only.

mainnetRequirements: treasury MUST be a Safe/multisig, not an EOA. It is immutable with no setter, so a lost key makes fee revenue permanently unrecoverable and the only remedy is redeploying the escrow and migrating every integrator.
Generate DATUM_PUBLISHER_KEY on an air-gapped machine. The testnet key used here has passed through repository-adjacent files.
Deploy.s.sol is chain-guarded to 84532; a mainnet deployment needs its own script and its own review.

smokeTests.ranAgainst: live Base Sepolia with real testnet USDC

seller.note: Throwaway testnet-only EOA generated for these tests; its key was never written to the repository.

1_anchorRealPrint.description: Signed a real print locally (worked example, reproduces Dated SIU $0.0383), anchored it, confirmed the event and stored timestamp, then confirmed re-anchoring reverts.

2_escrowSettleBelowMax.description: Full cycle with real USDC, settler = address(0). Fee charged on actualAmount only; buyer refund excludes fee.
2_escrowSettleBelowMax.quoteHashSource: packages/sdk quoteHashHex over a real signed datum-quote

assertedOnChain.provenBy: three distinct USDC Transfer events emitted from the escrow in the settle tx, one per destination

3_escrowExpiryReclaim.description: Second quote taken to expiry, then expire() reclaimed by the buyer. No fee is taken on an expiry refund.

4_quoteHashNotReusable.description: A quoteHash is single-use forever, whether it was settled or expired.

5_idempotentAnchoring.description: Verified live that re-running anchoring is safe: the first run anchors, subsequent runs report already-anchored and send no transaction. This is the 'dropped client after a landed transaction' case.

bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.bug: A reverted transaction was reported as a successful anchor.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.cause: viem's waitForTransactionReceipt resolves for reverted transactions too — a receipt means mined, not succeeded — and the receipt status was never checked.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.evidence: First idempotency attempt sent a duplicate postPrint (tx 0xab519e1ff6135e837574de77917ede8a62c94a1a19eb1aa22102224bd5f7bfc4) which mined with status 0, yet was reported as anchored.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.fix: on-chain.ts throws unless receipt.status === 'success'; anchorIdempotently then decides from contract state rather than from the transaction outcome.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.regressionTest: packages/print/src/anchor/idempotent.test.ts — 'does not report a reverted transaction as anchored'

bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.bug: Reading postedAt immediately after a mined transaction returned 0, so the next run re-sent.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.cause: Public RPC endpoints are load-balanced across nodes at different heights; a read can be served by one that has not caught up.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.evidence: Run 1 recorded a wall-clock posted_at with milliseconds (2026-08-16T06:49:54.026Z) instead of the on-chain second-precision timestamp, showing the read had answered 0.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.fix: readPostedAtWithRetry polls until the read is conclusive; only a non-zero answer is trusted.
bugsFoundOnLiveChainAndFixed.regressionTest: packages/print/src/anchor/idempotent.test.ts — 'tolerates RPC read lag right after a send instead of re-sending next run'

supersededAttempt.note: An earlier print (2026-08-16-idem, hash 0x7b270f36d9be823db8027ab4d55623f6442c411d99aa2be48ca18af3379ffed5) was anchored by tx 0xc7ae882ce92451598c5d465267cf268adc47fed3751772305c0186f617265201 while exposing the bugs above. Its duplicate send reverted on-chain and moved no state.

noAdminPathCheckedOnLiveBytecode.note: Each call fails against the deployed contract because no such function exists. test/NoAdminPath.t.sol asserts the same property structurally from the compiled ABI and bytecode.
